title: Ijwi riva mu gihuru gitwika
intro: Sobanura umwirondoro w'umuntu ukomeye, urugendo rwe rwatangiye ahura n'igitangaza, kandi iherezo rye ryari rifitanye isano no kubohorwa kw'ubwoko bwari bukandamijwe. Uyu muntu yatorewe umurimo ukomeye, ahura n'ibibazo bikomeye abifashijwemo n'Imana.
clues: Navukiye mu gihe cy'agahato gakomeye, aho impinja z'ubwoko bwanjye zicwaga.
Ubuzima bwanjye bwo hambere bwatumye umubyeyi wanjye ashyirwa mu ruzi, nyamara narabonetse kandi ndakurira mu muryango w’umunyagitugu w’ubwoko bwanjye.
Hari igihe nahunze umujyi nyuma yo kwica umuntu ntabigambiriye mu gihe cy'amakimbirane.
Nakiriye ubutumwa bw'Imana n'inkoni y'igitangaza ahantu hatagatifu, aho nategetswe guhangana n'umutegetsi ukomeye.
Mukuru wanjye yashinzwe kumfasha mu butumwa bwanjye, bitewe n'uko yabonaga ko ntari nzi neza mu mivugire yanjye.
Nayoboye abantu banjye yambuka inyanja yari yagabanutsemo kabiri, nhunga igitero cy'ingabo z'abanyagitugu.
arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى فَٱضْرِبْ لَهُمْ طَرِيقًۭا فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ يَبَسًۭا لَّا تَخَـٰفُ دَرَكًۭا وَلَا تَخْشَىٰ
verse: And We had inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants and strike for them a dry path through the sea; you will not fear being overtaken [by Pharaoh] nor be afraid [of drowning]." (20:77)
